data.revised_prompt:
Create exactly one clean HD 2D game FX sprite sheet, 2 rows by 2 columns, four equal cells, no visible grid lines or borders. Use the provided shrimp avatar images only as visual reference for identity, palette, material language, and attack personality: small blue-cyan/violet mantis-shrimp hero aesthetic, sharp shell-like shapes, bright aqua highlights, purple rim accents, fast claw-snapping attack style. This is attack FX only, not a character sheet.

Canvas: solid flat magenta background #FF00FF across the entire sheet, including the space between cells. No texture in background. No text, no labels, no numbers, no arrows, no watermark. No UI/card elements. Do not draw the shrimp character, no body parts, no eyes, no face, no full creature.

Layout: exactly 4 equal frames in a 2x2 grid. Each effect centered in its own cell, same visual scale and approximate bounding box, with generous magenta margin on all sides. Nothing may cross or touch any cell edge: no spark, bubble, crescent, shard, glow, trail, or outline touches edges.

Style: project-native clean HD 2D game attack FX, not pixel art. Crisp readable silhouettes, smooth hand-painted glows, polished underwater fantasy look, dark blue-violet outline accents, luminous cyan/aqua core, violet-purple edges.

Frame details:
Top-left frame 1: compact wind-up pressure bubble, a tight turquoise water-compression ring with tiny violet sparks and a faint claw-shaped crescent forming inside/along the ring.
Top-right frame 2: snap release, a narrow forward crescent shockwave like a shrimp claw strike, cyan core, violet edge, small bubbles pulled behind it, compact and centered.
Bottom-left frame 3: peak impact, bright aqua-white snap flash with short radial water shards, two small curved claw-trail marks, energetic but compact.
Bottom-right frame 4: fading afterimage, translucent violet-blue crescent residue, foam beads, small sparkling droplets collapsing inward.

Ensure the four frames read as one continuous attack effect sequence, with consistent scale and positioning inside each cell.
